comments.author: Alok Sharan
comments.comment:
Missing from this list: a production-grade agent needs a feedback loop, not just a one-time eval.

Most agent failures are due to state drift or compounding tool errors over time. Without a continuous feedback mechanism, you're flying blind after deployment.

What's the most surprising way an agent has failed in your system?

comments.author: Poornachandra Kongara
comments.comment: Most teams get stuck at level 8. In production, agents break less on prompts than on tool responses. I’d make evals for bad tool payloads, retries, and fallbacks level 9. What’s the hardest level you teach? #AgenticAI

comments.author: Benjamin Särkkä
comments.comment: A model API 403 should be a routing event, not a business outage. I keep prompts, tools, and evals in my own stack, so model choice is a config, not a rebuild. If your agent can't run with a local fallback plus a second provider, it's a demo, not infrastructure. What breaks first when your main provider bans you? #agenticAI

comments.author: Sameer Bhardwaj
comments.comment:
It's easier to break a production LLM system than it is to build one. My focus is always on the eval strategy first, before the agent design.

What's a specific failure mode you've had to build a detection for?

comments.author: Tim Yakubson 🚀
comments.comment: Outbound AI breaks on signal quality, not prompt cleverness. In agentic GTM systems, I’d measure enrichment accuracy, reply-to-meeting lift, and false-positive rate from week 1. Which metric moved fastest after the first 3 sessions? #GTM #AI #Clay

comments.author: Eric Roby
comments.comment: The hard part is that evals are statistical, not boolean: a backend unit test passes once, an LLM eval needs pass@k, drift tracking, and failure mode buckets. Do you gate deploys on eval pass rate, or on worst-case tail behavior? #AIEng

comments.author: Loïc Vanderschooten
comments.comment: Three harness rebuilds with an unchanged agent architecture are a signal: the problem was missing constraints, not missing capability. I would gate v4 with two numbers: time from idea to running agent, and eval pass rate on real tasks. What metric would make you stop rebuilding? #AgenticAI
